notes.title: New Upate
notes.content:
We just updated PaintLab with an update, it includes the following

- Intro sound
- Sound effects on material picker
- Sound effect when touching paint
- New Erase sound
- Fixed an Erase bug
- Changed size of glass material
- New Picker, this looks more like a magic want / arrow

We hope you like it, there are more updates coming.
